metadata.persistenceNote: This file defines the canonical DEFAULT electrical socket catalog and initial seed placements. Runtime additions and movements are read from and saved to the active PersistenceService adapter (js/persistence.js).

coordinateSystem.xAxis: East-West axis in mm (-285 to 20,705 mm)
coordinateSystem.zAxis: North-South axis in mm (-290 to 21,130 mm)
coordinateSystem.heightMm: Mounting height above finished floor in mm (e.g. 300 mm for wall sockets, 0 mm for floor sockets)
coordinateSystem.rotation: Orientation angle in degrees (0 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West)

socket_pe_shutter.name: Gniazdo ze stykiem ochronnym i zaślepką
